name: 远程工作台
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="20" height="14" x="2" y="3" rx="2"/><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="21" y2="21"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="17" y2="21"/><path d="m7 8 2 2-2 2"/><path d="M12 12h4"/></svg>
description: 共享 SSH 主机资产的远程工作台：分屏终端与会话恢复、多机任务与取消、主机分组及环境标记、按需健康检查、终端搜索与参数化命令片段、SFTP 文件浏览、持久隧道配置与重连，以及有界输出的 AI 远程命令。
descriptionEn: Shared SSH inventory with split terminals and session recovery, cancellable multi-host tasks, host groups and environment labels, on-demand health checks, terminal search and parameterized snippets, SFTP browsing, saved tunnels with reconnect, and bounded AI command output.
